title: Routes in scope, and how FDA route terms map to them
notes: In-scope categories are the owner's decisions of 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-11 (SYS-109). The mapping of FDA route terms to categories is a placeholder to be checked by the owner against the FDA route list and the live data (OD-042). Any FDA route not listed here, for example BUCCAL, TRANSDERMAL or any injection, is treated as outside scope.
